goal: Build a small Node.js task-manager CLI. The documented command must accept --data <file> to select a JSON data file and support add <title>, list, done <id>, and remove <id>. Tasks have unique stable IDs and a done flag. Support --json output for all commands. Preserve data across separate processes; a successful write must be atomic. Reject blank titles, unknown IDs, unknown commands, malformed existing data, and unwritable destinations with a nonzero exit code and a clear stderr message, without destroying valid existing data. Provide --help, README installation/usage instructions, and meaningful automated tests invoking the CLI in separate processes with temporary data files. Use only local filesystem storage and no external services.

requirements.behavior: --help exits zero and describes commands/flags; empty list emits valid empty JSON.
Add two titles including Unicode and spaces in separate processes; IDs distinct and stable; list returns exactly both tasks not done.
done changes only target flag; repeated done remains done; new process reads persisted state.
remove deletes only chosen ID; other task unchanged; different --data files are isolated.
Blank title, unknown ID/command, and malformed JSON each return nonzero with useful stderr and do not change existing bytes.
Unwritable/invalid destination fails clearly; successful mutation leaves a complete parseable file. Inject failure before replacement and verify original data survives.
All documented --json command outputs parse as JSON without progress text; success exit code is zero.
Clean-copy installation and README commands work; actual subprocess tests assert results; intentionally broken persistence/error-code fixtures fail acceptance.
